snippet.title: НАТО о ракетах России в Польше. Удары ВСУ по кораблям РФ. Гарантии безопасности Украине | Главное
snippet.description:
*В Брюсселе прошло внеочередное заседание Североатлантического совета НАТО после падения трех российских ракет на территории Польши. 

*Украина заявила об уничтожении российского корвета "Меркурий" у берегов Ливии. По словам Зеленского, морские дроны также поразили сухогруз "Ангара". Еще одно судно атаковали в Финском заливе – ответственность за этот удар Киев на себя не брал.

*22 часа под завалами. В Дымере Киевской области спасли пожилую женщину и мальчика – оба в больнице. Российская атака на жилой дом унесла жизни 11 человек. 

*США готовы рассмотреть гарантии безопасности для Украины по образцу пятой статьи НАТО. Но Москва отвергает такую идею и рассчитывает на новый раунд переговоров. 

*Компьютерным играм в России могут понадобиться прокатные разрешения. Эксперты предупреждают: российским компаниям станет сложнее конкурировать на международном рынке.

*В Киеве сотни кафе и ресторанов закрываются. Российские атаки и отключения света делают работу невыгодной. 

#россия #украина #новости

snippet.title: Our Keo on Our Clothes! 😂❤️
snippet.description:
Okay, this is our kind of couple goals! 😂❤️ We got the same Keo fabric sticker made for both of us!

My friend has an Instagram page where she sells fabric stickers, and when I found out she also does custom designs, I sent her a few pictures of Keo. 🐱❤️ She turned them into these adorable fabric stickers and even sent me a bunch of different designs!

The best part? They’re SO easy to stick — just 15–20 seconds and they’re ready! 😍

You can use them on plain sarees, T-shirts and other clothes to make them look more personal and fun. And she has so many different types of stickers too!

snippet.title: Steve Rogers Has A SON?! Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer Reaction 🔴
snippet.description:
The final Avengers: Doomsday trailer dropped on November 23, 2026. It hit 1 million views in 20 minutes. This is my full reaction plus every major reveal explained. December 17 in India, December 18 globally. We are less than one month away from the biggest MCU film ever.

Biggest Reveal: Steve Rogers Has A Teenage Son

The trailer opens with Steve Rogers (Chris Evans) living a quiet life with Peggy Carter (Hayley Atwell) in the branched timeline he left for at the end of Endgame (2019).

They have a teenage son. Played by Wesley Holloway. The son does NOT know his father was Captain America or an Avenger.

Steve's line to Peggy: "We made a choice that we knew was right. Why does it feel so wrong to lie to him?"

This opening scene officially debunks the viral "Steve Rogers is actually Loki in disguise" theory that dominated after the World Series teasers. The Steve Rogers in Doomsday is the REAL Steve. The one who returned the Infinity Stones. The one who lived his life with Peggy.

The Fantastic Four Recruits Steve

In the trailer, Reed Richards and the Fantastic Four arrive at Steve and Peggy's home. They need him for the fight against Doom. Steve has to break the news to his son that he was once Captain America.

This is the recruitment scene the entire first half of the trailer builds toward.

Avengers And X-Men Unite Against Sentinels

For the first time in cinematic history, the MCU's Avengers and the Fox X-Men fight side by side against the Sentinels in the X-Mansion. This is the moment comic book fans have been waiting decades to see on screen.

James Marsden's Cyclops delivers the iconic line: "To me, my X-Men!"

Chef's kiss moment.

Kate Bishop Is Officially In

Hailee Steinfeld returns as Kate Bishop. Her appearance was confirmed by her over the weekend and now shown in the trailer. She shares a scene with Kathryn Newton's Cassie Lang.

This almost certainly sets up the Young Avengers formation in Doomsday or Secret Wars.

More Confirmed Returns

Loki (Tom Hiddleston) appears in the trailer. God of Stories. Holding Yggdrasil together. Still in the fight.

Gambit (Channing Tatum) appears. The Fox X-Men universe character is now officially part of the Doomsday roster.

Thor (Chris Hemsworth) is shown wielding the Odinforce. His transformation into the All-Father may finally happen.

The New Avengers Tower

The former Thunderbolts (now officially the New Avengers) meet the Fantastic Four inside the New Avengers Tower. This is the big team unification moment. Sam Wilson leads the official Avengers. Yelena Belova leads the New Avengers. Reed Richards leads the Fantastic Four. All in one room.

Action Highlights

Aerial battles.
City-destroying fights.
Desert locations (possibly Latveria).
X-Mansion warfare.
Doctor Doom warping between scenes.

The "Stolen Lives" Theme

The trailer teases that Doctor Doom is coming for the Avengers because of "stolen lives." This connects to the Endgame Encore post-credit scene where Doom's TVA Monitor showed destroyed universes. Doom may view the Avengers' timeline manipulation (Endgame's time heist) as the trigger for the multiverse's collapse.

His revenge is personal.

The Russo Brothers' Survival Horror Promise

Directors Anthony and Joe Russo have teased that the third act of Doomsday turns into a "survival horror" experience. Not just a battle. A nightmare.

Doom is not a villain the Avengers can overpower. He is a villain they have to survive.

What's Still Hidden

The trailer does NOT show:
Wanda Maximoff (resurrected in the VisionQuest finale)
The Latverian Witches
Franklin Richards' role
How Doom's rivalry with Reed plays out
The Niko Bellic-style surprise cameos

Marvel is clearly saving the biggest reveals for the actual movie.

Countdown Is On

The trailer ends with a countdown clock. Avengers: Doomsday releases December 17, 2026, in India and December 18 globally.
